requirements.title: Per-query telemetry row
requirements.description: Each query writes a telemetry row (query hashed/opt-in, classified types, providers hit, per-provider counts, latency_ms, zero-result flag). No corpus content is stored.

validation.notes: A query produces one telemetry row with providers-hit, counts, and latency.

requirements.title: Insights aggregates
requirements.description: Status/insights compute per-provider utilization, under-utilized providers, zero-result rate, and p50/p95 latency from the telemetry table.

validation.notes: Under-utilized and zero-result aggregates compute correctly over seeded telemetry.
